description: This file contains unit tests for the GstSrc class, specifically testing the setup and configuration of app sources in a GStreamer pipeline, including handling of DRM, payloader, and queue elements, as well as failure scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoServerAppSrcGstSrcTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing GstSrc setup and behavior with mock GStreamer elements and callbacks.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and creates the GstSrc instance before each test.

methods.name: createGstSrc
methods.description: Creates the GstSrc object with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: expectSettings
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuration of the app source element, such as block, format, stream type, and min-percent.

methods.name: expectBin
methods.description: Sets expectation for adding an element to the GstBin.

methods.name: expectSetupPad
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and setting up a source pad for a given element.

methods.name: expectSyncElement
methods.description: Sets expectation for synchronizing the state of an element with its parent.

methods.name: expectLinkDecryptor
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and linking a decryptor element.

methods.name: expectLinkPayloader
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and linking a payloader element.

methods.name: expectLinkQueue
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and linking a queue element.
